void solve(const std::string& s, std::ostream& out) {
    int len = static_cast<int>(s.length());
    const char* a = s.c_str();
    int i = 0;
    int one = 0, two = 0;
    bool inside = false;
    while (i != len) {
        char c = a[i];
        if (c == '(') inside = true;
        else if (c == ')') inside = false;
        else if (std::isalpha(static_cast<unsigned char>(c))) i--;

            if (i == len || !std::isalpha(static_cast<unsigned char>(a[i]))) continue;

            int j = i;
            while (++i < len && std::isalpha(static_cast<unsigned char>(a[i])));
            one = std::max(one, i - j);
        }
    }
    out << one << " " << two << std::endl;
}
